text: {"protocol_id":"CTJ301UC201","version":"1.1","previous_version":"1.0","spoken_summary":"Protocol version 1.1 updates study rules and safety checks while showing missing visits and forms in the current database. These changes affect clinical site staff running patient visits and data managers updating the trial database.","changes":[{"id":"CH-1","section":"Cover Page (also Synopsis, 6.1 Figure 4) ","page":1,"quote":"Multicenter, international, across Mainland China, Taiwan, Republic of Korea and Australia","type":"admin","summary":"Replaced Germany with Australia as a participating study country/region.","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""},{"id":"CH-2","section":"Version of Protocol or Protocol Amendment","page":5,"quote":"VERSION OF PROTOCOL OR PROTOCOL AMENDMENT","type":"admin","summary":"Added a protocol version history table listing Version 1.0 and Version 1.1 issue dates.","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""},{"id":"CH-3","section":"Synopsis (also 2.2 Endpoints) ","page":7,"quote":"Change from Baseline to Week 12 in modified Mayo score (=full Mayo score excluding Physician’s Global Assessment (PGA) subscore). Change from Baseline to Weeks 4, 6, 8, 10, and 12 in PGA score. FDA-defined remission at Week 12, defined as Stool frequency subscore=0, Rectal bleeding subscore=0, and Endoscopy subscore =0 or 1.","type":"endpoint","summary":"Added three FDA-recommended secondary endpoints: change from Baseline in modified Mayo score at Week 12, change in PGA score at Weeks 4 to 12, and FDA-defined remission at Week 12.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add individual Mayo subscore fields (stool frequency, rectal bleeding, PGA, and endoscopy) to the MAYO and PMAYO forms, which currently capture only total scores."},{"id":"CH-4","section":"3.1.2 Overall Design (also Synopsis, 4.2.2, 9.6.2) ","page":26,"quote":"90 patients will be centrally, dynamically, randomly assigned to 3 groups (1:1:1) to receive 600mg TJ301 biweekly (Q2W), 300mg TJ301 Q2W or placebo Q2W. Randomisation will be stratified by prior corticosteroids treatment (yes/no) and consent to participate in PK substudy (yes/no).","type":"procedure","summary":"Changed randomisation stratification factors from elevated CRP and stable conventional treatment to prior corticosteroids treatment (yes/no) and PK substudy consent (yes/no).","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Capture prior corticosteroid and PK substudy stratification factors at V1 as well as RAND at V2 (where STRATCS and PKSUB already exist) and use PKSUB to trigger dynamic PK subgroup visits."},{"id":"CH-5","section":"3.1.2 Overall Design (also Synopsis, 6.1, 6.2.5) ","page":27,"quote":"At 1st dose: pre-dose and 0.5, 1, 2 (end of infusion), 6, 48, 144 (Day 6), and 240 (Day 10) h after the start of the 1st administration;","type":"schedule","summary":"Changed the post-dose PK blood sampling timepoint after the 1st and 6th doses from 1.5 hours to 2 hours (end of infusion).","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Update the PKTPT codelist on the PK form from 1.5 h to 2 h (EOI), which is already configured as '2 h (EOI)' in the current build."},{"id":"CH-6","section":"3.3 Safety Review Committee","page":29,"quote":"A Safety Review committee (SRC) will be established. The SRC is an expert advisory group commissioned and charged with the responsibility of evaluating, primarily, cumulative safety data at regular intervals.","type":"admin","summary":"Renamed the safety oversight body from Data and Safety Monitoring Committee (DSMC) to Safety Review Committee (SRC) and removed benefit-risk assessment wording from its remit.","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""},{"id":"CH-7","section":"3.4.7 Follow-up Procedures (also Synopsis) ","page":33,"quote":"For patients completing the trial, a Safety Follow-up Visit will be scheduled on Day 105 (Week 15). For patients not completing the trial, a Safety Follow-up Visit will be scheduled 35 days (5.8 - 6.6 half-lives of TJ301) after the last dose of IMP.","type":"admin","summary":"Reordered the sentences describing Safety Follow-up Visit timing for completing versus non-completing patients as an editorial change.","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""},{"id":"CH-8","section":"4.1.1 Inclusion Criteria (also Synopsis, 6.1 Table 1) ","page":34,"quote":"During Day -35 to Day-6 prior to Randomisation, an endoscopy subscore ≥2.","type":"eligibility","summary":"Shortened the allowable screening endoscopy window from Day -60 to Day -6 to Day -35 to Day -6 prior to Randomisation.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add an edit check on the ENDO form at V1 to verify that ENDODTC falls within Day -35 to Day -6 prior to V2 randomisation."},{"id":"CH-9","section":"4.1.1 Inclusion Criteria (also Synopsis, 3.1.2, 6.2.1) ","page":34,"quote":"Treated with conventional non-biological UC therapy: with corticosteroids stable for at least 2 weeks prior to Randomization at no more than 20 mg prednisone (or equivalent), and/or with medications containing 5-aminosalicylates (5-ASA) at no less than 2 g 5-ASA per day for at least 3 months and stable for at least 4 weeks prior to Randomization, and/or with azathioprine (AZA) at no less than 1.5 mg/kg/day or mercaptopurine (6-MP) at no less than 0.75 mg/kg/day for at least 6 months and stable for at least 6 weeks prior to Randomization.","type":"eligibility","summary":"Lowered the minimum daily 5-ASA dose required in Inclusion Criterion 5 from 3 g/day to 2 g/day to align with Taiwan guidelines.","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""},{"id":"CH-10","section":"4.1.1 Inclusion Criteria (also Synopsis) ","page":34,"quote":"The subject should be able to read and write to understand and fill out Patient Diary.","type":"eligibility","summary":"Added Inclusion Criterion 8 requiring subjects to be able to read and write to understand and complete the Patient Diary.","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""},{"id":"CH-11","section":"4.1.2 Exclusion Criteria (also Synopsis) ","page":34,"quote":"Current diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease unclassified, Crohn's disease, ischemic colitis, fulminant colitis and/or toxic megacolon, patients with ulcerative colitis limited to the rectum (ulcerative proctitis), infective enteritis, amebic bowel disease and intestinal schistosomiasis.","type":"eligibility","summary":"Updated Exclusion Criterion 5 terminology from 'indeterminate colitis' to 'inflammatory bowel disease unclassified'.","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""},{"id":"CH-12","section":"4.1.2 Exclusion Criteria (also Synopsis) ","page":35,"quote":"Presence or history of active tuberculosis (TB) or latent TB infection, defined as 1) a positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold test at Screening, or 2) a positive T-spot test within 4 weeks of Randomisation and evidence of current or previous pulmonary tuberculosis by chest X-ray within 12 weeks of Randomisation.","type":"eligibility","summary":"Expanded Exclusion Criterion 17 to exclude patients with latent TB infection defined by QuantiFERON-TB Gold or T-spot plus chest X-ray criteria.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Expand the TB form at V1 with structured fields for QuantiFERON-TB Gold or T-spot test results/dates and chest X-ray findings/dates to evaluate latent TB exclusion."},{"id":"CH-13","section":"5.1 Treatments Administered","page":39,"quote":"Manufacturer: Octoplus Development B.V. (now as Dr. Reddy’s Research &Development B.V.), Netherlands","type":"admin","summary":"Corrected the IMP manufacturer name from OctoPlus N.V. to Octoplus Development B.V. (now Dr. Reddy's Research & Development B.V.).","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""},{"id":"CH-14","section":"5.1 Treatments Administered (also Synopsis, 5.4, 6.1) ","page":39,"quote":"The infusion time is 2 hours.","type":"procedure","summary":"Removed the ±3 minute tolerance from the 2-hour IMP infusion duration.","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""},{"id":"CH-15","section":"5.5.2 Unblinding of Individual Patient Treatment","page":41,"quote":"If the Sponsor needs to unblind a treatment, the reason and the date of opening should be recorded with signature, following corporate standard operational procedures for unplanned unblinding of clinical trial patients. It should be recorded in the subject’s source documents that the code is broken, why, when and by whom.","type":"admin","summary":"Clarified that Sponsor-initiated unblinding must be documented in the subject's source documents.","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""},{"id":"CH-16","section":"6.1 Trial Flowchart (Table 1) ","page":44,"quote":"Alcohol and tobacco habits","type":"schedule","summary":"Alcohol and tobacco habits assessment at Visit 1 (Screening) is required by the protocol schedule but absent from the current EDC build.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add an Alcohol and Tobacco Habits form scheduled at Visit 1 (Screening)."},{"id":"CH-17","section":"6.1 Trial Flowchart (Table 1) (also 6.2.5) ","page":45,"quote":"For Mainland China PK subgroup only. At 1st dose: pre-dose and 0.5, 1, 2 (end of infusion), 6, 48, 144 (Day 6), and 240 (Day 10) h after the start of the 1st administration; At the 2nd, 3rd , 4th, and 5th administrations blood samples will be collected pre-dose and at the end of infusion; At 6th dose: pre-dose and 0.5, 1, 2 (end of infusion), 6, 48, 144 (Day 76), 240 (Day 80), 336 (Day 84), 480 (Day 90), and 840 h (Day 105) after the start of the 6th administration.","type":"schedule","summary":"Seven PK subgroup intermediate visits (V2.1, V2.2, V2.3, V7.1, V7.2, V7.3, and V8.1) and their post-dose PK timepoints (48 h, 144 h, 240 h, and 480 h) are required by the protocol but absent from the current EDC build.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add dynamic PK events V2.1 (Day 2), V2.2 (Day 6 ±1d), V2.3 (Day 10 ±1d), V7.1 (Day 72), V7.2 (Day 76), V7.3 (Day 80 ±1d), and V8.1 (Day 90 ±2d) triggered by RAND.PKSUB='Yes', attach the PK form (extending CMP_PK_01 and SDV100), and add '48 h', '144 h', '240 h', and '480 h' to PKTPT."},{"id":"CH-18","section":"6.1 Trial Flowchart (Table 1) ","page":45,"quote":"Biomarkers erythrocyte sedimentation rate [ESR], C-reactive protein (CRP), neutrophil and platelet count tests will be be analysed in local sites. IL-6, IL-6/sIL-6R complex, and faecal calprotectin tests will be analysed in central lab. At Visits 2 and 8, the patient should be in a fasting state ( ≥8 hours).","type":"schedule","summary":"Blood sampling for exploratory biomarkers (ESR, CRP, neutrophil and platelet count, IL-6, IL-6/sIL-6R complex, with fasting ≥8 hours at V2 and V8) at Visits 2, 4, 6, and 8 is missing from the current EDC build.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add a Blood Sampling for Biomarkers form (including fasting status at V2 and V8) scheduled at V2, V4, V6, and V8."},{"id":"CH-19","section":"6.1 Trial Flowchart (Table 1) ","page":45,"quote":"Includes haematology, clinical chemistry, coagulation tests, and urinalysis assessments. Clinical laboratory test should be conducted -5 to -1 days prior to Randomisation.","type":"schedule","summary":"Clinical laboratory tests (haematology, clinical chemistry, coagulation tests, and urinalysis) scheduled at Visits 1.1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9 are missing from the current EDC build.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add Clinical Laboratory Test forms (haematology, clinical chemistry, coagulation, and urinalysis) scheduled at V1.1, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, and V9."},{"id":"CH-20","section":"6.1 Trial Flowchart (Table 1) ","page":45,"quote":"Stool sample for Clostridium difficile assay","type":"schedule","summary":"Stool sample collection for Clostridium difficile assay at Visit 1 (Screening) is required by the protocol schedule but absent from the current EDC build.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add a Clostridium difficile Stool Assay form scheduled at Visit 1 (Screening)."},{"id":"CH-21","section":"6.1 Trial Flowchart (Table 1) ","page":46,"quote":"Serum pregnancy test at Visit 1 and urine pregnancy test at Visits 8 and 9.","type":"schedule","summary":"Pregnancy testing (serum at Screening/Visit 1.1 and urine at Visits 8 and 9) is required by the protocol schedule but absent from the current EDC build.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add a Pregnancy Test form dynamically restricted to female subjects at V1.1 (per Table 1/Section 6.2.2; verify V1 wording in footnote h/7.1.4), V8, and V9."},{"id":"CH-22","section":"6.1 Trial Flowchart (Table 1) (also 7.1.2) ","page":46,"quote":"A complete physical examination will be performed at Visits 1 (Screening) and 9 (Follow-up). Body weight only will be measured at Visits 1.1, 4, 6 and 8.","type":"schedule","summary":"Removed physical examination at Visits 3, 5, and 7 (retaining complete exams at V1 and V9 and body weight only at V1.1, V4, V6, and V8), and the Physical Examination form is absent from the current EDC build.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add a Physical Examination form capturing complete examination at V1 and V9 and body weight only at V1.1, V4, V6, and V8 (excluding V3, V5, and V7)."},{"id":"CH-23","section":"6.2.2 Screening Period (also 6.1 Table 1, 6.2.3) ","page":49,"quote":"At the Screening Visit, a Paper Diary (Appendix 3) will be dispensed to the patients to be used for the reporting of daily stool frequency and rectal bleeding (blood in stool). Patients will be instructed on the use of the Paper Diary. The Paper Diary will be returned at each visit.","type":"schedule","summary":"Added Diary dispensing and Diary review at Visit 2 (Section 6.2.3), and Diary dispensing (V1, V1.1, V2 to V7) and Diary review (V1.1, V2 to V8) are missing from the current EDC build.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add Diary Dispensing (V1, V1.1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7) and Diary Review (V1.1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8) forms to the EDC build."},{"id":"CH-24","section":"6.2.4 12-week Treatment Period (also 6.1 Table 1) ","page":50,"quote":"Blood sampling for anti-TJ301 antibodies (Visits 3, 4, 6, and 8) ","type":"schedule","summary":"Added blood sampling for anti-TJ301 antibodies (ADA) at Visit 3, and the anti-TJ301 antibody form across all scheduled visits (V2, V3, V4, V6, V8, and V9) is missing from the current EDC build.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add an Anti-TJ301 Antibodies (ADA) blood sampling form scheduled at V2, V3, V4, V6, V8, and V9."},{"id":"CH-25","section":"7.1.1 Clinical and Endoscopic Disease Activity (Mayo Score) ","page":53,"quote":"Note that the criteria of endoscopic appearance assessment in this study are DIFFERENT from the original criteria in (13). The Endoscopy subscore is modified so that a value of 1 does not include friability. Personnel responsible for endoscopic evaluation should NOT refer to the original criteria.","type":"endpoint","summary":"Added an explicit requirement that endoscopic appearance criteria differ from the original Mayo criteria so that an Endoscopy subscore of 1 excludes friability.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add a modified endoscopic appearance subscore field and codelist (excluding friability from score 1) to the ENDO and MAYO forms."},{"id":"CH-26","section":"7.1.3 Vital Signs (also 6.1 Table 1) ","page":55,"quote":"Vital signs will be measured at Visits 1, 1.1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 and will include blood pressure (measured after the patient has been in a seated position for ≥3 minutes of rest), pulse, respiration rate, and body temperature.","type":"schedule","summary":"Vital signs assessments at Visits 1, 1.1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9 are required by the protocol schedule but absent from the current EDC build.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add a Vital Signs form (seated systolic/diastolic blood pressure, pulse, respiratory rate, and body temperature) scheduled at V1, V1.1, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, and V9."},{"id":"CH-27","section":"7.1.5 Electrocardiogram (also 6.1 Table 1) ","page":55,"quote":"In this trial, a routine 12-lead ECG will be performed at Visits 1, 1.1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9. The ECG measurements will include heart rate and PR, QRS, and QT intervals.","type":"schedule","summary":"Routine 12-lead ECG assessments at Visits 1.1 (and Visit 1 per Section 7.1.5), 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9 are required by the protocol schedule but absent from the current EDC build.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add a 12-lead ECG form (heart rate, PR, QRS, and QT intervals, and clinical significance) scheduled at V1.1, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, and V9 (confirming V1 alignment with Table 1)."},{"id":"CH-28","section":"7.3.4 Concomitant Medication Review (also 6.1 Table 1) ","page":56,"quote":"Data concerning concomitant medications and procedures will be collected throughout the trial at all site visits. These data will be obtained at scheduled or unscheduled trial visits based on information provided spontaneously by the patient or as a result of questioning the patient.","type":"schedule","summary":"General concomitant medications documentation across Visits 1 through 9 is required by the protocol schedule but absent from the current EDC build, which only captures stable conventional UC therapy.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add a general Concomitant Medications form/log scheduled at V1, V1.1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, and V9 alongside CM_STAB."},{"id":"CH-29","section":"7.3.5 Urine Screening for Drugs of Abuse (also 6.1 Table 1) ","page":56,"quote":"At the Screening Visit, a urine drug screening (e.g. cocaine, barbiturates, amphetamines, opiates, benzodiazepine, and cannabinoids) will be performed. Clinical significance of a positive urine drug screen will be assessed by the Investigator.","type":"schedule","summary":"Urine drug screening at Visit 1 (Screening) is required by the protocol schedule but absent from the current EDC build.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add a Urine Screening for Drugs of Abuse form scheduled at Visit 1 (Screening)."},{"id":"CH-30","section":"8.3 Adverse Events of Special Interest","page":61,"quote":"Adverse events of special interest include adverse events observed in earlier clinical development of TJ301 and those resulting from blocking IL-6 signaling shown by other drugs or investigational products. Certain side effects were observed early on during the clinical development program for TJ301, including infusionrelated reactions, headache, nasopharyngitis, myalgia, diarrhoea, cough, and decreased neutrophil count.","type":"safety","summary":"Added Section 8.3 defining Adverse Events of Special Interest (AESI) for TJ301 and IL-6 inhibitor class effects.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Add an Adverse Event of Special Interest (AESI) flag/classification field to the AE form."},{"id":"CH-31","section":"8.5.2 Collection, Recording and Reporting of Serious Adverse Events","page":64,"quote":"CRO contact information: Zhijia Han E-mail: zhijia.han@tigermed.net","type":"admin","summary":"Updated the CRO safety reporting contact from Haiyan Liu to Zhijia Han.","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""},{"id":"CH-32","section":"Appendix 2 – Laboratory Parameters","page":87,"quote":"HIV (HIV-1/2 Antigen and Antibodies) HBV (Hepatitis B Surface Antigen) HCV (Hepatitis C Antibody) TB (QuantiFERON-TB Gold; or T-spot test plus chest X-ray) EBV [Viral capsid antigen (VCA)-IgM test and VCA-IgG test] CMV (if applicable; CMV DNA load by real-time polymerase chain reaction assay) ","type":"procedure","summary":"Added specific screening assay requirements for HIV, HBV, HCV, TB, EBV, and CMV (specifying real-time PCR CMV DNA load).","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Replace the single text fields on VIRO and TB with assay-specific fields for HIV-1/2 Ag/Ab, HBsAg, HCV Ab, EBV VCA-IgM/IgG, CMV DNA PCR, and QuantiFERON-TB Gold or T-spot plus chest X-ray."},{"id":"CH-33","section":"Appendix 3 – Patient Diary (blank sample) ","page":89,"quote":"Patients should indicate the most severe category that describes the amount of blood they had in their stools for a given day. Among the categories of rectal bleeding, “streaks of blood with stool” means streaks of blood with stool less than half the time, “obvious blood with stool” means obvious blood (more than just streaks) or streaks of blood with stool most of the time. Patients should select “No Blood Seen” in the rectal bleeding section if they do not have stool during a given day.","type":"procedure","summary":"Added patient instructions to Appendix 3 defining stool events and rectal bleeding severity categories for completing the Patient Diary.","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""},{"id":"CH-34","section":"Appendix 4 – Summary of Changes for Version 1.1 (also 6.1 Table 1, 6.3) ","page":90,"quote":"Add TB test at Safety Follow-up Visit.","type":"safety","summary":"Added TB testing at the Safety Follow-up Visit (Visit 9) due to potential TB risk with TJ301.","affects_edc":true,"edc_note":"Schedule the TB form at Visit 9 Safety Follow-up (already present at V1 and V9 in the current EDC build)."},{"id":"CH-35","section":"Appendix 4 – Summary of Changes for Version 1.1 (Throughout the protocol) ","page":92,"quote":"‘corticosteroids’ is more appropriate than ‘glucocorticosteroids’.","type":"admin","summary":"Replaced the term 'glucocorticosteroids' with 'corticosteroids' throughout the protocol.","affects_edc":false,"edc_note":""}]}
